quadrature: three unit blocks, each axis cut toward the re-entrant corner (1, 1) at L*0.5^j (j = 1..level), n_per_cell^2 Gauss points per cell; level 0 is the training quadrature
reference: graded Q2 FEM (n = 8, beta = 3) modes 1-3, displacement and gradient evaluated at the quadrature points; Lam_fem is the FEM eigenvalue
neural: p4_params_raw.npz networks, re-projected on each quadrature with the raw-storage convention of their own arm
